summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Periodo + Tipo filter bar in 'Historial de actividades' (page Registrar Actividad). All scenarios from the review request passed: pill visibility, month/year picker toggling, filtering by period, filtering by tipo, combined filters, and empty-state message.

test_results_detail.pills_visible: hoy, semana, mes, año, todo all visible
test_results_detail.period_filter_table: TODO=7 rows, MES=2026-05=5 rows, MES=2000-01=0 rows (empty msg shown), AÑO=2026=7 rows, AÑO=2021=0 rows
test_results_detail.tipo_filter_table: Options=[Todos los tipos, cosechar, deshierbar, fertilizacion, fungicida]. Tipo=cosechar -> 2 rows; reset -> 7 rows

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: the count badge selector span:has-text('actividad') was ambiguous in tests because the sidebar item 'Actividades' matches; not a UX bug but consider adding a data-testid like 'actividades-historial-count' to the span 'X de Y actividad(es)' for easier QA.
Period 'semana' uses Sunday as week start (now.getDay()); fine for ES locales but worth confirming product intent (Monday-based weeks are more common in LatAm work contexts).
